page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server belonging to the ecs.gn5 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 8 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 60.0 GB of system memory, which provides 7.5 GB of RAM per core. The instance is provisioned with a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps to handle data transfers.

The server features integrated hardware acceleration consisting of two NVIDIA P100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 32 GB of VRAM. For local data storage, the instance includes 944 GB of local SSD storage, offering high-speed read and write performance directly attached to the virtual machine.

This hardware profile is designed for parallel processing workloads. It is suitable for deep learning training and inference, scientific simulations, video transcoding, and database operations that benefit from dedicated CPU cores, local SSD storage, and dual-GPU acceleration.
